description: A Clothing card dropped on another. The photo of from_garment_id becomes the back, side or detail view of garment_id, and from_garment_id leaves the board (deleted only when it is a fresh drop nothing else uses). Or a photo put in the brief's missing-photo slot: image_url instead of from_garment_id, nothing leaves the board. The board's draft brief is saved again when the view changes it. Returns the board (and brief); asking again answers status unchanged.

board_id.description: The open Shoot Board's board_id, from Open Shoot Board or your context.

expected_revision.description: Board revision this write is based on; a stale revision returns a revision_conflict error with the current board instead of overwriting it

from_garment_id.description: the board garment whose photo it is; it leaves the board

garment_id.description: the board garment that gains the photo as a view

image_url.description: instead of from_garment_id: the stored photo (host file download URL, or the image_url mcp_upload_intake_photo returned)

name: mcp_add_garment_view
title: Add Garment View
